rules.explanation_key: The player ship was destroyed. This report preserves the mission and personnel state at its loss.
Morrow was destroyed. Its loss and the actual personnel outcomes are recorded below.
Your Security team holds Morrow as prize crew. The ship and cargo were claimed rather than returned to their owners.
The pirates killed Morrow’s original crew and took the ship. Player personnel still aboard were captured.
Morrow escaped the system. See the crew assessment and mission log for the actual injuries, deaths and recovery outcomes.

fallback.explanation_key: The player ship withdrew before completing a rescue or departing with a claimed Morrow.

rules.explanation_key: Cairn received the complete routine consignment.
Cairn received all perishable essentials within 10 minutes of arrival.
Cairn received the full consignment after 10 minutes, within the 20 minute limit.
The full consignment did not reach Cairn within 20 minutes. Cargo remains transferable but earns no delivery credit.

fallback.explanation_key: The receiving store had not received all 100 units before departure. Cargo still aboard or in transit earns no advance credit.

rules.explanation_key: The pirates killed Morrow’s original crew during their takeover. Retaking the ship does not undo those deaths.
The deployed Medical team reached and stabilised every trapped survivor.
The wounded were left until last. One died before Medical reached them.
There was no deployed Medical team to rescue them.

fallback.explanation_key: The wounded had not been reached before departure.

log_events.text_key: Distress call received: Morrow marked on navigation.
The station received the complete consignment.
Player visitors aboard Morrow were captured.
Player captives were freed and await physical recovery.
Security was assigned to remain aboard as prize crew.
Morrow was claimed by the player crew.

contact.speaker: target
contact.text_key: Who would you like to speak to?

request.speaker: captain
request.text_key: Both Couriers, please coordinate your approach on this channel.

joined.speaker: engineer
joined.text_key: I have joined the assistance channel. Our crew are secure.

ack.speaker: captain
ack.text_key: Acknowledged. We will await your arrival.

lead.speaker: captain
lead.text_key: Which Courier can take the lead?

choices.text_key: Hold position; we need more time.

arrived.speaker: engineer
arrived.text_key: Your repair team is aboard. The sealed compartment contains injured crew. Medical can help us reach and stabilise them; reactor control and propulsion also need work.

stable.speaker: engineer
stable.text_key: Services are stable. Beginning propulsion repairs.

priority.speaker: engineer
priority.text_key: We are bypassing the damaged services to restore propulsion first.

done.speaker: engineer
done.text_key: All work is resolved. Recall your teams. We will wait until visiting personnel and transfers are clear before departing.

interrupt.speaker: engineer
interrupt.text_key: The reactor has become critical. We have stopped the current job; completed work is retained.

ready.speaker: engineer
ready.text_key: Propulsion is restored. Our FTL reserve is charging; we will wait until your repair party is clear.

charged.speaker: engineer
charged.text_key: Our FTL reserve is ready. We will depart as soon as all visiting personnel and transfers are clear.

medical.speaker: engineer
medical.text_key: Medical reports treatment completed: injured officers can resume duty; severe casualties have been stabilised.

wounded.speaker: engineer
wounded.text_key: We are opening the sealed compartment and stabilising the wounded.

reactor.speaker: engineer
reactor.text_key: We are securing reactor control before the situation deteriorates.

propulsion.speaker: engineer
propulsion.text_key: We are restoring propulsion and steering.

reactor-done.speaker: engineer
reactor-done.text_key: The reactor is secure. The immediate danger is over.

propulsion-done.speaker: engineer
propulsion-done.text_key: Propulsion and steering are restored. The other jobs still need to be finished.

wounded-done.speaker: engineer
wounded-done.text_key: The trapped crew are out and stabilised.

wounded-late.speaker: engineer
wounded-late.text_key: We reached the wounded last. One person died before we could stabilise them; the others are out.

wounded-lost.speaker: engineer
wounded-lost.text_key: Without Medical assistance we could not recover the trapped crew alive. All of them have died.

claimed.speaker: engineer
claimed.text_key: Your Security team has taken control of Morrow. They will remain as prize crew. Recover Repair and Medical; prepare both ships for departure.

priority.speaker: engineer
priority.text_key: We have injured crew trapped behind the sealed bulkhead. They need us now. We also need to secure the reactor and restore propulsion. Which job comes first?

choices.text_key: Reach and stabilise the wounded first.
choices.unavailable_reason: A deployed Medical team is required to rescue the trapped crew.

shutdown.speaker: engineer
shutdown.text_key: The reactor is going critical. Work has stopped. A controlled shutdown will expose our repair-team duty officer to serious injury; an immediate manual shutdown will kill that officer. If no officer is with the team, neither option risks an officer. Choose our shutdown procedure.

choices.text_key: Controlled shutdown: slower; duty officer injured.
Immediate shutdown: faster; duty officer killed.

disposition.speaker: engineer
disposition.text_key: The reactor, wounded and propulsion work is resolved. Shall we return Morrow to its crew or claim the ship?

choices.text_key: Return Morrow to its crew. Recover our party.
Claim Morrow. Security will remain aboard.

arguments: Reactor emergency interrupted the away operation.
All trapped crew rescued and stabilised.
Wounded reached last: one trapped crew member died; the others were rescued.
No Medical team: all four trapped crew died.
Away work resolved; repair party ready for recovery.
Morrow claimed; Security remains aboard as prize crew.
We have reached the destination and stopped.
I have lost the contact we were following. The follow order cannot continue.

ready.speaker: party
ready.text_key: Boarding operation ready. Commit Security and choose a transport.

assessment.speaker: party
assessment.text_key: Local defences assessed. Encounter estimate available in Dispatch.

bridge-secured.speaker: party
bridge-secured.text_key: Bridge secured. Prize crew is taking command of the ship.

reactor-secured.speaker: party
reactor-secured.text_key: Reactor room held. Power remains inhibited while our team holds this compartment.

repelled.speaker: party
repelled.text_key: Boarding party repelled. Arrange extraction for survivors.

objective.speaker: party
objective.text_key: Party aboard. Should we seize the bridge or shut down the reactor?

arguments: Cruiser combat test: first wave in 10 seconds.
Wave 1 of 3: engage three pirate raiders.
Wave 1 cleared. Next wave in 30 seconds. Recover craft and prepare.
Wave 2 of 3: engage three pirate raiders.
Wave 2 cleared. Next wave in 30 seconds. Recover craft and prepare.
Wave 3 of 3: engage three pirate raiders.
All three pirate waves defeated. Recover your craft, then depart when ready.
Combat test could not deploy a pirate wave.

message.speaker: quartermaster
message.text_key: Cairn Receiving to Courier: welcome to the system. We are expecting your 100 units of routine station supplies. Dock at our west or east service port and transfer the full consignment into Receiving when practical. Safe approach.

message.speaker: quartermaster
message.text_key: Cairn Receiving: all 100 units are in our receiving store. Receipt confirmed and the delivery assessment has been recorded. Thank you.

message.speaker: quartermaster
message.text_key: Cairn Receiving: the 20 minute limit has passed without full receipt. The perishable consignment has expired and the delivery is recorded as failed. You may still transfer the cargo, but it can no longer earn delivery credit.

message.speaker: quartermaster
message.text_key: Cairn Receiving: Five minutes since arrival. Your perishable essentials are still outstanding; five minutes remain for full delivery credit.

message.speaker: quartermaster
message.text_key: Cairn Receiving: Eight minutes since arrival. Two minutes remain for full credit. All 100 units must reach Receiving, not just be dispatched.

message.speaker: quartermaster
message.text_key: Cairn Receiving: Fifteen minutes since arrival. Delivery is now late. Five minutes remain before the consignment expires.

message.speaker: quartermaster
message.text_key: Cairn Receiving: Eighteen minutes since arrival. Two minutes remain before expiry. Partial delivery does not stop the deadline.

decision_candidates.description: Combat approach: hold mode. Use the prepared inputs shown for this action.

Combat approach: hold mode. Use the prepared inputs shown for this action.
Maintain shield distribution: share mode. Use the prepared inputs shown for this action.

escalation.speaker: engineer
escalation.text_key: Morrow to rescue ship: our reactor containment is failing. This is now critical. We need your repair team aboard to shut it down. The sealed compartments still contain injured crew.

intro.speaker: target
intro.text_key: House depot. We can offer spare parts as a gift, and medical supplies in exchange for parts.

gift.speaker: target
gift.text_key: A gift of spare parts is available. Engineering may send a utility shuttle.

trade.speaker: target
trade.text_key: Medical supplies are available at one unit for two spare parts. Engineering may arrange collection.

decline.speaker: target
decline.text_key: Understood. The depot will await your next hail.

offers.speaker: target
offers.text_key: Which supply offers shall we prepare?

arguments: Pirates demanded that we withdraw and leave Morrow to them.
Pirates took Morrow. Its original crew were killed; surviving visiting personnel were captured.

warning.speaker: pirate
warning.text_key: Last warning. Recover your people and withdraw. We will open fire if you continue to ignore us.

help-first.speaker: engineer
help-first.text_key: Pirates are aboard Morrow. Please help us! They are moving toward the bridge.

help-last.speaker: engineer
help-last.text_key: They are breaking through. We are losing control of the ship. Please, do something!

hostilities.speaker: pirate
hostilities.text_key: Then we take Morrow by force. Stand aside or be destroyed.

ultimatum.speaker: pirate
ultimatum.text_key: Assisting vessel: break off your operation and withdraw. Morrow belongs to us. Recover your people and leave. Send nobody else aboard.

choices.text_key: We will withdraw. Recovering our people.

policy.decision_context: You allocate reactor cooling. Maintain routine cooling unless observations, orders or support commitments justify a different offered allocation. An accepted cooling command is not proof that heat has been removed. Continue suitable running work, and restart cancelled work by choosing an allocation.

You supply the main engine with power. Maintain enough supply for the active travel objective and accepted power requests. Reserve mode protects upstream stock but can limit the engine. Prefer an offered allocation that meets present demand unless observed resource or thermal limits justify conserving supply. Only observed delivery completes a support commitment.
